{"updated_at":"2012-02-29T16:47:12Z","forks":[],"url":"https://api.github.com/gists/2729810","comments":0,"public":true,"git_pull_url":"git://gist.github.com/2729810.git","files":{"fail_github.py":{"type":"application/python","raw_url":"https://gist.github.com/raw/2729810/2fb3aa84e0efa50dc0f4c18b5df5b7b9ab27076b/fail_github.py","size":1636,"filename":"fail_github.py","content":"import httplib
import base64
import json

login = ""
password = ""
orgName = ""
repoName = "FailGithubApi"

def doRequest( verb, url, input ):
    input = json.dumps( input )
    cnx = httplib.HTTPSConnection( "api.github.com", strict = True )
    cnx.request( verb, url, input, { "Authorization" : "Basic " + base64.b64encode( login + ":" + password ).replace( '\n', '' ) } )
    response = cnx.getresponse()
    status = response.status
    output = response.read()
    cnx.close()
    print verb, url, input, "=>", status, output
    print
    if status < 200 or status >= 300:
        exit( 1 )
    return json.loads( output )

# Create a repo
doRequest( "POST", "/user/repos", { "name": repoName } )

# Create a blob, a tree, a commit and the master branch
b = doRequest(
    "POST", "/repos/%s/%s/git/blobs" % ( login, repoName ),
    { "content": "Content of the blob", "encoding": "latin1" }
)
t = doRequest(
    "POST", "/repos/%s/%s/git/trees" % ( login, repoName ),
    { "tree" : [ { "path": "foo.bar", "type": "blob", "mode": "100644", "sha": b["sha"] } ] }
)
c = doRequest(
    "POST", "/repos/%s/%s/git/commits" % ( login, repoName ),
    { "parents": [], "message": "Message of the commit", "tree": t["sha"] }
)
doRequest(
    "POST", "/repos/%s/%s/git/refs" % ( login, repoName ),
    { "ref": "refs/heads/master", "sha": c["sha"] }
)

# Fork the repo
doRequest( "POST", "/repos/%s/%s/forks?org=%s" % ( login, repoName, orgName ), None )

# Create a new blob => BOOM error 500
doRequest(
    "POST", "/repos/%s/%s/git/blobs" % ( orgName, repoName ),

import base64
import json

login = ""
password = ""
orgName = ""
repoName = "FailGithubApi"

def doRequest( verb, url, input ):
    input = json.dumps( input )
    cnx = httplib.HTTPSConnection( "api.github.com", strict = True )
    cnx.request( verb, url, input, { "Authorization" : "Basic " + base64.b64encode( login + ":" + password ).replace( '\n', '' ) } )
    response = cnx.getresponse()
    status = response.status
    output = response.read()
    cnx.close()
    print verb, url, input, "=>", status, output
    print
    if status < 200 or status >= 300:
        exit( 1 )
    return json.loads( output )

# Create a repo
doRequest( "POST", "/user/repos", { "name": repoName } )

# Create a blob, a tree, a commit and the master branch
b = doRequest(
    "POST", "/repos/%s/%s/git/blobs" % ( login, repoName ),
    { "content": "Content of the blob", "encoding": "latin1" }
)
t = doRequest(
    "POST", "/repos/%s/%s/git/trees" % ( login, repoName ),
    { "tree" : [ { "path": "foo.bar", "type": "blob", "mode": "100644", "sha": b["sha"] } ] }
)
c = doRequest(
    "POST", "/repos/%s/%s/git/commits" % ( login, repoName ),
    { "parents": [], "message": "Message of the commit", "tree": t["sha"] }
)
doRequest(
    "POST", "/repos/%s/%s/git/refs" % ( login, repoName ),
    { "ref": "refs/heads/master", "sha": c["sha"] }
)

# Fork the repo
doRequest( "POST", "/repos/%s/%s/forks?org=%s" % ( login, repoName, orgName ), None )

# Create a new blob => BOOM error 500
doRequest(
    "POST", "/repos/%s/%s/git/blobs" % ( orgName, repoName ),
    { "content": "Content of the new blob", "encoding": "latin1" }
)

The class [IssueEvent](https://github.com/PyGithub/PyGithub/blob/master/github/IssueEvent.py) is missing a large number of attributes documented in the [API](https://developer.github.com/v3/issues/events/).

This is also commented about in #653 to a degree

27 of the tests 27 known event types have tests.

**Currently Tested using Issue #30**            
- [x] subscribed
- [x] assigned
- [x] referenced               
- [x] closed                   
- [x] labeled                  

**Currently Tested using Issue/PR #538**
- [x] merged
- [x] mentioned
- [x] review_requested

**Currently Tested using Issue/PR #857**
- [x] reopened
- [x] unassigned
- [x] unlabeled
- [x] renamed
- [x] base_ref_changed
- [x] head_ref_deleted 
- [x] head_ref_restored

- [x] moved_columns_in_project

- [x] converted_note_to_issue - Note: this event is tied into Issue #866

import base64
import json

login = ""
password = ""
orgName = ""
repoName = "FailGithubApi"

def doRequest( verb, url, input ):
    input = json.dumps( input )
    cnx = httplib.HTTPSConnection( "api.github.com", strict = True )
    cnx.request( verb, url, input, { "Authorization" : "Basic " + base64.b64encode( login + ":" + password ).replace( '\n', '' ) } )
    response = cnx.getresponse()
    status = response.status
    output = response.read()
    cnx.close()
    print verb, url, input, "=>", status, output
    print
    if status < 200 or status >= 300:
        exit( 1 )
    return json.loads( output )

# Create a repo
doRequest( "POST", "/user/repos", { "name": repoName } )

# Create a blob, a tree, a commit and the master branch
b = doRequest(
    "POST", "/repos/%s/%s/git/blobs" % ( login, repoName ),
    { "content": "Content of the blob", "encoding": "latin1" }
)
t = doRequest(
    "POST", "/repos/%s/%s/git/trees" % ( login, repoName ),
    { "tree" : [ { "path": "foo.bar", "type": "blob", "mode": "100644", "sha": b["sha"] } ] }
)
c = doRequest(
    "POST", "/repos/%s/%s/git/commits" % ( login, repoName ),
    { "parents": [], "message": "Message of the commit", "tree": t["sha"] }
)
doRequest(
    "POST", "/repos/%s/%s/git/refs" % ( login, repoName ),
    { "ref": "refs/heads/master", "sha": c["sha"] }
)

# Fork the repo
doRequest( "POST", "/repos/%s/%s/forks?org=%s" % ( login, repoName, orgName ), None )

# Create a new blob => BOOM error 500
doRequest(
    "POST", "/repos/%s/%s/git/blobs" % ( orgName, repoName ),
    { "content": "Content of the new blob", "encoding": "latin1" }
)

I have to add all these paths to my include paths:


  ../Libraries/of_preRelease_v007_linux64/libs/openFrameworks
  ../Libraries/of_preRelease_v007_linux64/libs/openFrameworks/app
  ../Libraries/of_preRelease_v007_linux64/libs/openFrameworks/3d
  ../Libraries/of_preRelease_v007_linux64/libs/openFrameworks/communication
  ../Libraries/of_preRelease_v007_linux64/libs/openFrameworks/gl
  ../Libraries/of_preRelease_v007_linux64/libs/openFrameworks/graphics
  ../Libraries/of_preRelease_v007_linux64/libs/openFrameworks/utils
  ../Libraries/of_preRelease_v007_linux64/libs/openFrameworks/types
  ../Libraries/of_preRelease_v007_linux64/libs/openFrameworks/math
  ../Libraries/of_preRelease_v007_linux64/libs/openFrameworks/events



It is common to instead structure files like (in the case of openFrameworks):

oF/include/oF
oF/include/oF/app
oF/include/oF/3d
oF/include/oF/communication
oF/include/oF/gl
oF/include/oF/graphics
...etc...

and just write:

#include <of/ofMain.h>
#include <of/communication/ofSerial.h>

etc.

I'm not sure if there is an argument to leave it like it is because it's easier for oF's demographic? this would be really awesome. there is already some code in ofDrawBitmapString that's using gluProject, it would be good to clean it up.

the main issue is that glu is not on iOS, so we'd need to find/write our own implementation.

here's a first pass:

	GLdouble modelviewMatrix[16], projectionMatrix[16];
	GLint viewport[4];
	void updateProjectionState() {
		glGetDoublev(GL_MODELVIEW_MATRIX, modelviewMatrix);
		glGetDoublev(GL_PROJECTION_MATRIX, projectionMatrix);
		glGetIntegerv(GL_VIEWPORT, viewport);
	}

	ofVec3f ofWorldToScreen(ofVec3f world) {
		updateProjectionState();
		GLdouble x, y, z;
		gluProject(world.x, world.y, world.z, modelviewMatrix, projectionMatrix, viewport, &x, &y, &z);
		ofVec3f screen(x, y, z);
		screen.y = ofGetHeight() - screen.y;
		return screen;
	}

	ofVec3f ofScreenToWorld(ofVec3f screen) {
		updateProjectionState();
		GLdouble x, y, z;
		screen.y = ofGetHeight() - screen.y;
		gluUnProject(screen.x, screen.y, screen.z, modelviewMatrix, projectionMatrix, viewport, &x, &y, &z);

		return world;

If you take for instance "graphicsExample" an you add:

```glEnable( GL_CULL_FACE );```

Somewhere you will no longer see much drawn to screen.

GL_CCW is the default FrontFace for OpenGL, but OF seems to be the opposite.
http://www.khronos.org/opengles/sdk/docs/man/xhtml/glFrontFace.xml

Which is coolio of course, as long as we are consistent.

Our options are either to throw a ```glFrontFace( GL_CW );``` in there somewhere OR re-write all the drawing to be consistent with OpenGL default, not sure what is the best in the long run.

What say you all?

import base64
import json

login = ""
password = ""
orgName = ""
repoName = "FailGithubApi"

def doRequest( verb, url, input ):
    input = json.dumps( input )
    cnx = httplib.HTTPSConnection( "api.github.com", strict = True )
    cnx.request( verb, url, input, { "Authorization" : "Basic " + base64.b64encode( login + ":" + password ).replace( '\n', '' ) } )
    response = cnx.getresponse()
    status = response.status
    output = response.read()
    cnx.close()
    print verb, url, input, "=>", status, output
    print
    if status < 200 or status >= 300:
        exit( 1 )
    return json.loads( output )

# Create a repo
doRequest( "POST", "/user/repos", { "name": repoName } )

# Create a blob, a tree, a commit and the master branch
b = doRequest(
    "POST", "/repos/%s/%s/git/blobs" % ( login, repoName ),
    { "content": "Content of the blob", "encoding": "latin1" }
)
t = doRequest(
    "POST", "/repos/%s/%s/git/trees" % ( login, repoName ),
    { "tree" : [ { "path": "foo.bar", "type": "blob", "mode": "100644", "sha": b["sha"] } ] }
)
c = doRequest(
    "POST", "/repos/%s/%s/git/commits" % ( login, repoName ),
    { "parents": [], "message": "Message of the commit", "tree": t["sha"] }
)
doRequest(
    "POST", "/repos/%s/%s/git/refs" % ( login, repoName ),
    { "ref": "refs/heads/master", "sha": c["sha"] }
)

# Fork the repo
doRequest( "POST", "/repos/%s/%s/forks?org=%s" % ( login, repoName, orgName ), None )

# Create a new blob => BOOM error 500
doRequest(
    "POST", "/repos/%s/%s/git/blobs" % ( orgName, repoName ),
    { "content": "Content of the new blob", "encoding": "latin1" }
)
